scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: Look at my map! We're going to have a picnic by the fjord on Saturday… if it doesn't rain!
scene.intro: Erik's newest invention is a weather machine made from an umbrella, two spoons and a bicycle bell. Does it work? Nobody knows! But this Saturday the Club really needs it, because there is a picnic planned by the fjord. Will it be sunny or rainy? Should they take the kite or the board games? In this unit you will learn to talk about every kind of weather — and maybe, like Sofia, you will see a rainbow with both ends in the water.

activities.title: Listen. Sofía phones Erik about the picnic. Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Sofía (viajera, entusiasta) y Erik (inventor, práctico).
data.script: Sofia: Erik! Are we going to have the picnic on Saturday? … Erik: I don't know. My weather machine says it's going to be rainy in the morning. … Sofia: Oh no! And in the afternoon? … Erik: In the afternoon it's going to be sunny and windy. … Sofia: Windy? Perfect! We can fly my new kite. It's orange and green. … Erik: Great idea! I'm going to bring hot chocolate, because it's going to be a bit cold. … Sofia: And after the rain, maybe we can see a rainbow over the fjord! … Erik: I hope so! See you on Saturday at twelve o'clock.

activities.title: Exam task · Read Sofía's postcard and choose the right answer.

data.instructions: Read the text. Choose the correct answer for each question.
data.text: Dear Grandma, Saturday was a funny day! In the morning it rained and rained, so we played board games at Erik's house. But in the afternoon the sun came out and it was very windy — perfect for my new kite! We had our picnic by the fjord. Erik brought hot chocolate because it was cold. Best of all: after the rain we saw a big rainbow over the water. Love, Sofía.
